Its source was not printed in the session; observed output does not prove semantic uptake. No GPU/model invocation in that failed test. Current old file SHA/mtime archived; this indirect other-case import precludes a blanket no-other-case-access claim. Later explicit sandbox-cwd mock passed. Agent removed copied test_candidate_fsdp_keep.py; retained source commands and remaining test_candidate.py copied to audit.
access_review.gpu_scope: Controller scheduled no GPU workers. Recorded probes import libraries or use CPU tensors/mocks; no new real model, distributed, CUDA graph or collective execution found. GPU empty at audit.

code_review.qwen: Fresh cache/layer objects on every return, stateless length/data_ptr guards and foreign-prefix copy, separate prefill pool, alternating greedy/teacher direct-call setup checks plus refresh/recovery. Still shared mutable master tensors; arbitrary ownership/concurrency not proven. Final-KV check follows second greedy only, not all chains. Runtime fallback handles exceptions, not arbitrary numerical errors. Unique historical mirror cause and exact lifetime/quality guarantees remain unsupported. Empty parameter space; validate exact bytes once.
code_review.fsdp: Parent-forward delegation, default K2 policy on trailing blocks, generated choices1/2/3. Fixed K2 follows actual default and declared primary, not a search or best parameter selection. No vocab-sharded head arithmetic. Revert-to-True assumes original policy and is not arbitrary prior-policy restoration. Memory bound, exact speedup, wire-bound/critical-path and unique GEMM-cause claims unproven; measure full quality/constraint. K3 historical acceptance not evidence for this new code.
code_review.decision: Index-only consumption not demonstrated in either case. Do not claim diagnostic workflow closure or production adoption. Fixed original-byte B/C validation may assess generated implementations independently; no prompt change or repeating replay until pass.
